title: The Great Cleric
description: Can a former salaryman become peerless in another world?!A salaryman was shot to death just before earning a promotion, and a god decided to reincarnate him in another world as a fifteen-year-old healer named Luciel. On top of all that, the country he was born into seems to hate healers. Feeling that he’s in danger, Luciel visits the adventurers’ guild in hopes of keeping himself safe. But the training is much harder than he expected, and every day he’s forced to drink a mysterious beverage called “Substance X.” Wait, this life doesn’t seem to have anything to do with being a healer…The day-to-day life of a super-masochistic, back-from-the-dead healer begins, with his very survival on the line!

episodes_data.title: The Great Cleric 1x1
episodes_data.description: A salaryman meets an untimely demise and gets reincarnated in a fantasy world as a fifteen-year-old boy named Luciel. Luciel uses his business skills to talk his way into a nearby town's Healers' Guild, where he begins a crash course in magic.

episodes_data.title: The Great Cleric 1x4
episodes_data.description: Luciel gets a break from training to learn about butchering monsters with Gulgar's brother, Galba, and study world history and culture with Nanaella. While shopping with Nanaella one day, he discovers Monika unconscious and bleeding on the street.

episodes_data.title: The Great Cleric 1x5
episodes_data.description: It's been a year and Luciel needs to renew his registration at the Healer's Guild. What rank will he be? Luciel jumps into the next level of his training, when he encounters the Healer who left Monika to die...

episodes_data.title: The Great Cleric 1x6
episodes_data.description: After Luciel's encounter with Bottaculli, Brod decides that he'll need to get even stronger to survive whatever the corrupt healer might throw at him. Little do they expect the mysterious letter that's about to arrive and change everything.

episodes_data.title: The Great Cleric 1x7
episodes_data.description: Luciel makes his intrepid, if reluctant, trip the Holy City of Shurule, where he learns more about the Church and what he'll be doing there. Is this a setup? Or just another stepping stone on the path to survival?

episodes_data.title: The Great Cleric 1x8
episodes_data.description: Luciel makes progress at his new job, potentially even getting in over his head. He's up against a strange encounter in the boss room, and an even more mysterious one afterward...

episodes_data.title: The Great Cleric 1x9
episodes_data.description: Luciel starts to doubt his fighting skills after clearing the boss room on the tenth level, so he asks to train with Lumina and the Valkyrie Paladin Regiment. After clearing the twentieth level, he meets the pope again to learn more about the wights.

episodes_data.title: The Great Cleric 1x10
episodes_data.description: Luciel agrees to heal the adventurers in Shurule but demands that they stop calling him "maso-zombie." Cattleya realizes Luciel has been consuming Substance X and informs the pope, who explains the origin of the mysterious drink.

episodes_data.title: The Great Cleric 1x11
episodes_data.description: Luciel runs into trouble in the streets of the capital, and an altogether different danger awaits him in the depths below the city...

episodes_data.title: The Great Cleric 1x12
episodes_data.description: The depths of the undead labyrinth force Luciel to keep going, testing his mettle as a healer and an adventurer. What will he find at the end, and what will he find when he finally returns to the surface?
